Game Overview

Stickman Blast is a fighting title where survive waves of relentless enemies as a lone stickman warrior in Stickman Blast. Armed with only a sword and quick reflexes, defend your base by clicking and earning coins to upgrade skills and hire allies. Face the infinite horde and see how long your stand can last!
